name: Stone Path
summary: Breadcrumbs as stepping stones across a river: open a folder and a stone drops in with a splash
about: A breadcrumb bar for a file browser drawn as stepping stones over a flowing river. Opening a folder drops a new stone into the water with a shadow, a splash of droplets and ripples, while the folder list rises in; picking an earlier stone makes the later ones sink one by one with bubbles. When the path gets too long for the river, the middle stones tuck into a small stone with a menu, and the stone you stand on sends out a slow ripple now and then.
how: Click a folder in the list to go deeper; click a file to see its preview note.
Click any earlier stone, press Up one level, Backspace or Alt and Left Arrow to go back.
On a long path, open the small stone with three dots to jump to a hidden folder.
A short demo walk plays by itself until you click or press a key.
